_meta.description: Weighted OVR calculation configuration for all football positions

changelog.1.1.0: Tuned RB/QB/EDGE weights to improve draft position distribution (reduce RB/EDGE over-representation, increase QB representation)

validation_rules.weight_sum: All position weights must sum to exactly 1.0
validation_rules.override_semantics: override_base/override_side replace defaults for this position
validation_rules.missing_stats: Use neutral value (50.0) if stat missing from player

base_weights._comment: Universal attributes applying to ALL positions. Default ~23% total.

offensive._comment: Skills shared by offensive players. Default ~16% total.

defensive._comment: Skills shared by defensive players. Default ~24% total.

special_teams._comment: Special teams have minimal shared attributes beyond position-specific kicking skills.

_rationale: QB is the most mentally demanding position in football.
Throw accuracy remains critical but not sole determinant.
Decision-making, anticipation, and awareness all contribute to elite QB play.
Arm strength (throw_power) and composure under pressure matter significantly.
Physical attributes (speed, strength) are nice-to-haves, not requirements.
Blocking/catching virtually never matter for QBs.
TUNING v2: AGGRESSIVE flattening - throw_power boosted (mu=84 is highest), accuracy reduced
TUNING v2: Top-2 stats now 30% (18+12) vs 36% (22+14) vs original 44% (26+18)
QB._additional_stats_note: QB weights v2: throw_accuracy 22->18%, throw_power 12->16% (leverages high mu=84), decision_making 14->12%, reaction_time 8->10%

_rationale: RB requires balance of athleticism and football-specific skills.
Vision (awareness) and balance determine yards after contact.
Catching increasingly important in modern football (receiving backs).
Blocking critical for pass protection - differentiates complete backs.
Speed is public/measurable; balance, blocking, awareness require scouting.
TUNING: Reduced speed/balance weight, increased blocking to create differentiation (2026-01-22)
RB._additional_stats_note: RB balance retuned: less pure athleticism (speed/balance reduced), more football skills (blocking/awareness increased)

_rationale: WR success is primarily about catching the ball and getting open.
Route running is the craft that creates separation.
Speed is critical for stretching the field and after-catch yards.
Agility enables quick cuts and route breaking.
Blocking matters for screens and run support but is secondary.
Speed is public; route_running requires film study (scoutable).
TE is the ultimate hybrid - must block AND catch.
Blocking is slightly more important as many TEs are blocking-first.
Receiving TEs need catching and route running.
Size (represented via strength) matters for both roles.
Speed is less critical than WR but still valuable for mismatches.
Balance of skills makes this a complex position to evaluate.
OL is ALL about blocking - pass protection and run blocking.
Strength is critical for holding ground against DL/EDGE.
Balance and footwork matter for pass sets and pulling.
Awareness is crucial for reading blitzes and making line calls (especially C).
Speed is virtually irrelevant except for pulling guards.
Catching never matters. Agility has minor importance.
Blocking is scoutable; strength is public.
Interior DL must stop the run first, then rush the passer.
Strength and shedding blocks are fundamental.
Run defense (gap discipline) separates good from great.
Pass rush matters but less than for EDGE players.
Speed is minimal; these are power players.
Tackling matters when they get to the ball carrier.
Most skills require film study (scoutable).
DL._additional_stats_note: DL prioritizes run stopping; strength/shedding are key battle stats

_rationale: EDGE rushers must excel at both pass rush and run defense.
Pass rush is critical but not sole determinant of elite EDGE.
Acceleration and first-step quickness create pressure.
Speed around the edge is essential for speed rushers.
Strength matters for power moves, setting edge, and shedding blocks.
Tackling and awareness matter for complete defensive ends.
Pass rush is scoutable; acceleration/speed are public.
TUNING: Reduced pass_rush dominance, increased run defense skills (2026-01-22)
ITERATION 2: Further reduced pass_rush 20%->16%, boosted tackling/strength/awareness (2026-01-22)
EDGE._additional_stats_note: EDGE iteration 2: pass_rush 16% (was 20%), strength 12% (was 10%), awareness 8% (was 6%), tackling 12% (was 10%), shedding_blocks 8% (was 10%) - flatter distribution reduces elite EDGE concentration

_rationale: LB is the most versatile defensive position - tackle, cover, rush.
Tackling is fundamental - LBs make the most tackles.
Awareness/instincts let them read plays and flow to the ball.
Coverage matters in modern NFL with RBs/TEs as weapons.
Speed determines range sideline-to-sideline.
Strength for taking on blocks.
Scoutable stats dominate (tackling, coverage, awareness).
LB._additional_stats_note: LB is defined by side-of-ball versatility; must tackle, cover, and shed blocks

_rationale: CB is an island position - coverage ability is paramount.
Speed is critical to keep up with fast WRs (public stat).
Agility for mirroring cuts and breaks in routes.
Press coverage for disrupting timing at the line.
Reaction time for breaking on the ball.
Tackling matters less but still important for run support.
Coverage and press_coverage are scoutable; speed/agility public.
CB._additional_stats_note: CB is coverage-first; speed/agility gate the position; tackling secondary

_rationale: Safety is the last line of defense - must do everything.
Coverage and tackling both critical - can't sacrifice one.
Speed for range covering the deep part of the field.
Awareness/instincts for reading plays and being in position.
Run support (tackling) important, especially for SS.
More balanced than CB between run/pass responsibilities.
Mix of public (speed) and scoutable (coverage, awareness) stats.
S._additional_stats_note: S must balance run/pass responsibilities; awareness is critical for reads

_rationale: Kicker is purely about making kicks under pressure.
Kick accuracy is THE stat - you either make it or you don't.
Kick power determines range (how far you can attempt).
Composure critical for high-pressure game-winning kicks.
Focus for consistency over the course of a game/season.
Physical attributes (speed, strength) virtually irrelevant.
Accuracy/power are public; composure is scoutable.
Punter needs power for distance and hang time.
Accuracy for directional kicking and coffin corner punts.
Composure for performing under pressure (e.g., bad snaps).
Slightly more athletic than K - sometimes need to tackle.
Focus for consistency through adverse conditions.
Physical attributes matter slightly more than K but still minimal.

_balance_analysis._comment: Analysis of weight distribution patterns across positions for gameplay balance.

skill_concentrated.pattern: Position-specific weights dominate (78-92%). Core skills define the position.
skill_concentrated.gameplay_implication: Clear tier separation. Elite prospects obvious, busts obvious.
skill_concentrated._note: EDGE moved to balanced_skill after pass_rush weight reduction (2026-01-22)

balanced_skill.pattern: Position-specific weights (40-44%) balanced with athleticism (32-40%) and technique (20-24%).
balanced_skill.gameplay_implication: Complete players favored. Pure athletes or pure technicians may disappoint.
balanced_skill._note: EDGE weight distribution flattened further in iteration 2: now 40/40/20 (2026-01-22-v2)

athleticism_driven.pattern: Base stats (speed/agility) comprise 36% of OVR, side skills 28-38%.
athleticism_driven.gameplay_implication: Public stats heavily influence evaluation. Less scouting variance.
athleticism_driven._note: RB removed after tuning shifted focus to blocking/football skills (2026-01-22)

versatility_required.pattern: Side-of-ball overrides are 30-52%. Must do multiple things well.
versatility_required.gameplay_implication: Harder to find elite prospects. More 'safe' picks.
versatility_required._note: RB added after tuning increased blocking weight to 16% (2026-01-22)

power_based.pattern: Strength (16%) and blocking (38%) dominate at 54% combined.

public_stat_heavy.scouting_implication: Less uncertainty. What you see is what you get.

scoutable_stat_heavy.scouting_implication: High evaluation uncertainty. Investment in scouting pays off.

qb_flattened.observation: QB has 78% weight on position-specific stats. Top stat reduced from 26% to 18%. throw_power boosted 12%->16% (mu=84).
qb_flattened.effect: More QBs reach elite OVR: leverages high throw_power mean, reduces throw_accuracy variance penalty.

rb_rebalanced.observation: RB blocking weight increased to 16%, speed reduced to 12%, balance reduced to 14%.
rb_rebalanced.effect: RBs must be complete players. Pure athletes less likely to dominate OVR rankings.

edge_distributed.observation: EDGE pass_rush reduced 26%->20%->16%. Strength/tackling/awareness increased. Weight distribution now 0.40/0.40/0.20.
edge_distributed.effect: Flatter EDGE weights reduce elite concentration. Complete defenders favored over pure pass rushers.

ol_compression.observation: OL relies on blocking(38%) + strength(16%) + balance(14%) = 68% of OVR.
ol_compression.effect: OL OVRs will cluster more. Fewer outliers in either direction.

cb_speed_gate.observation: CB speed weight is 12% (vs 5% base). Coverage at 30%.
cb_speed_gate.effect: Slow CBs severely penalized. Speed is a hard floor.

lb_versatility.observation: LB has 0% position-specific weights; entirely base(48%) + side(52%).
lb_versatility.effect: LBs evaluated on fundamental football skills. Very few 'bust' candidates.

kp_specialist_isolation.observation: K/P have 88-92% weight on kicking-specific stats.
kp_specialist_isolation.effect: K/P evaluation is almost entirely separate from other positions.

balance_verification_checklist: No position has >40% weight on a single stat (except OL blocking at 38%)
All positions have base stat representation (8-56% range)
Defensive positions properly weight tackling (6-22% range)
Offensive skill positions properly weight catching (14-24% range)
Special teams properly isolated from standard evaluation
Speed importance scales correctly: CB(12%) > WR(12%) > RB(12%) > EDGE(8%) > DL(2%) > OL(2%)

stats_requiring_addition_to_positions_js._note: These stats are used in OVR weights but may not exist in positions.json. The calculator will use neutral (50.0) for missing stats.
stats_requiring_addition_to_positions_js.recommendation: Add these stats to positions.json distributions for accurate OVR calculation.
